name: goodkind
tagline: A little good goes a long way.
description: A generous identity for a neighborhood mutual-aid collective. A smiling loop, surprising tomato red, and friendly typography make participation feel easy.
heading: rubik
rules: The smile remains open at the top; do not turn it into a closed badge.

system.concept: Embracing shapes, riso-style overprinting, neighborhood notices, and welcoming rounded lettering. Warmth comes from the sense that many people belong here.
headline: A little good.
A lot of together.
system.productNote: Something good to be part of.
features: Small, useful actions that begin with the people around you.
A community that gets better with every different perspective.
Share an idea, a skill, a little time, or a helping hand.
